maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is asset management fees on client assets under management in active investment strategies, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Fees come from institutions, intermediaries, funds and individual investors, mostly private clients, not government payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by building autonomous investment teams and strategies organically and through market appreciation, not regular acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Clients can redeem or move investment mandates to other managers; switching has some friction but no operational or regulatory disruption.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgement call; investment management mandates are movable.
